''See also: [[Erastes Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Erastes is a captain within the [[Damascan army]], characterized by his weathered appearance, short [[Iron|iron-gray]] hair, and [[steel]]-colored eyes. A lifelong soldier, he is regarded as a quintessential representative of the [[Damascan]] military, which serves as an extension of [[Zakareth]]'s [[Authority|authority]]. While he does not possess the supernatural speed or strength of a [[Valinhall Travelers|Valinhall Traveler]], his extensive combat experience makes him a highly skilled swordsman. He has previously served in peacekeeping roles and had intended to retire to live with the [[Agnos family]] after his final assignment. Throughout various encounters, Erastes has demonstrated a serious and disciplined nature, treating everyone with respect regardless of age. His history includes conflict with [[Simon]], whom he blamed for the loss of his life's plans and the death of his men. In combat, he is shown to be capable and resilient, utilizing various weapons including a [[sword]], a hammer, and the crimson [[Ragnarus blade]]. He has also been seen wearing a soldier's uniform that differs from the red-and-gold attire reserved for those under direct royal command, and he bears black chain markings on his arm.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Erastes sat beside [[Chaka]] while eating fruit. He rejected an offer from [[Olissa Agnos|Olissa]] to serve as a guardian and is currently engaged in combat with [[Benson]]. Additionally, he refers to [[Leah]] by the title of [[Queen]].}}
